description.zh: 地址池列表。
description.en: The list of addresses in the address pool.

description.zh: 地址。
description.en: The address.

description.zh:
地址归属信息, JSON字符串格式。

- lineCode：归属线路Code
- lineCodeRectifyType：归属线路订正类型，默认：自动订正
    - NO_NEED 不订正
    - RECTIFIED 已订正
    - AUTO 自动订正
description.en:
The source region of the address. This parameter is a JSON string.

- lineCode: The line code of the source region.

- lineCodeRectifyType: The rectification type for the line code. Default value: AUTO.

  - NO\_NEED: No rectification is performed.

  - RECTIFIED: The line code is rectified.

  - AUTO: The line code is automatically rectified.

description.zh: 权重。
description.en: The weight.

description.zh:
模式：

- SMART：智能返回
- ONLINE：永远在线
- OFFLINE：永远离线
description.en:
The mode. Valid values:

- SMART: smart return

- ONLINE: always online

- OFFLINE: always offline

description.zh: 备注。
description.en: The remarks.

description.zh: 连续失败次数。
description.en: The number of consecutive failed health checks.

description.en: The health check interval. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 监控城市节点列表。当 MonitorStatus 为 OPEN 状态时，节点列表中至少应配置一个有效节点。
description.en: The list of health check nodes. If MonitorStatus is set to OPEN, you must specify at least one valid health check node.

description.zh:
城市Code。当 MonitorStatus 为 OPEN 状态时，CityCode不能为空。

具体取值可参考：DescribeDnsGtmMonitorAvailableConfig接口返回数据。
description.en:
The city code. If MonitorStatus is set to OPEN, CityCode is required.

For information about the valid values, see the response of the DescribeDnsGtmMonitorAvailableConfig operation.

description.zh:
当 MonitorStatus 为 OPEN 状态时，IspCode不能为空。
具体取值可参考：DescribeDnsGtmMonitorAvailableConfig接口返回数据。
description.en:
If MonitorStatus is set to OPEN, IspCode is required.
For information about the valid values, see the response of the DescribeDnsGtmMonitorAvailableConfig operation.

description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language of some returned parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

description.zh:
负载均衡状态：

- ALL_RR：返回全部地址
- RATIO：按权重返回地址
description.en:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- ALL\_RR: returns all addresses.

- RATIO: returns addresses by weight.

description.zh:
扩展信息，各协议检查所需参数：
- HTTP(S)：

	- port：检查端口
	- host：Host设置
	- path：URL路径
	- code：返回码（大于此值会被判定为异常）。取值：400、500。
	- failureRate：失败比例
	- sni：是否开启sni，仅在HTTPS协议时使用。
	    - true-开启
	    - 其他-未开启
	- nodeType：地址池类型为DOMAIN时，健康检查监控节点类型：
	    - IPV4
	    - IPV6

- PING：

	- failureRate：失败比例
	- packetNum：ping包数目
	- packetLossRate：丢包率
	- nodeType：地址池类型为DOMAIN时，健康检查监控节点类型：
	    - IPV4
	    - IPV6

- TCP：

	- port：检查端口
	- failureRate：失败比例
	- nodeType：地址池类型为DOMAIN时，健康检查监控节点类型：
	    - IPV4
	    - IPV6
description.en:
The extended information. This parameter is a JSON string. The required parameters vary based on the health check protocol:

- HTTP and HTTPS:

  - port: The health check port.

  - host: The host settings.

  - path: The URL path.

  - code: The return code. A response with a status code greater than this value is considered abnormal. Valid values: 400 and 500.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - sni: Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI). This parameter is available only for the HTTPS protocol.

    - true: Enable SNI.

    - Other values: Disable SNI.

  - nodeType: The type of the health check node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- PING:

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - packetNum: The number of ping packets.

  - packetLossRate: The packet loss rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the health check node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

- TCP:

  - port: The health check port.

  - failureRate: The failure rate.

  - nodeType: The type of the health check node when the address pool type is DOMAIN. Valid values:

    - IPV4

    - IPV6

description.zh:
健康检查开启状态（默认CLOSE），若OPEN则校验健康检查配置，否则抛弃

- OPEN：开启
- CLOSE：关闭
description.en:
The status of the health check feature. Default value: CLOSE. If you set this parameter to OPEN, the health check configuration is verified. Otherwise, the configuration is ignored.

- OPEN: enabled

- CLOSE: disabled

description.zh: 地址池名称。
description.en: The name of the address pool.

description.zh:
检查协议：

- HTTP
- HTTPS
- PING
- TCP
description.en:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

- HTTP

- HTTPS

- PING

- TCP

description.zh: 超时时间，单位毫秒。
description.en: The timeout period. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
地址池类型：

- IPV4：ipv4地址
- IPV6: ipv6地址
- DOMAIN：域名
description.en:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

- IPV4: IPv4 address

- IPV6: IPv6 address

- DOMAIN: domain name
